items.title: White Shimmer
items.goal: Broad crossing frost planes sweep through a complete white ship while deterministic facets and sparks reveal crystalline detail.

intent.concept: Broad crossing frost planes sweep through a complete white ship while deterministic facets and sparks reveal crystalline detail.
intent.design_intent: Replace low-resolution whole-rig glitter with legible crystalline motion: broad Hull sweeps, a protected counter-moving contour edge, hero Jewelry diamonds, restrained Organ cohorts, and a fully engraved Identity surface.
intent.why_exists: It provides the white family's fine-detail vocabulary without risking blackout or making every fixture sparkle equally.
intent.visual_goal_titanic: From playa distance the outline and signs remain stable; nearby, the rail diamonds should be the clearest and brightest native-white points over subtler frost elsewhere.
intent.unique_topology: Two broad oblique crystalline planes intersect over deterministic XYZ facets and point sparks; fixture-local six-head diamonds and a complete folded 74-pixel frost engraving refine the direct-view families.
intent.distance_silhouette: The Silhouette carries a continuous white floor plus sparse stars, never a field of disconnected black gaps.
intent.close_detail: High-power Jewelry diamonds, crystalline Hull grain, fixture-cohort Organ stars, and fine sign frost create multiple scales of detail.
intent.motion_grammar: Counter-moving signed frost planes create large readable sweeps while deterministic facets and sparks move at subordinate rates; long wraps and parameter slew prevent seams and edit jumps.
intent.xyz_use: Centered X/Y/Z feed both deterministic hashes and the oblique frost bed; pixelLocalIndex authors the six-head Jewelry. Identity computes signIndex = index % 74 and remaps that folded address into one complete 10x8/74-pixel local surface; both physical 40+34 signs therefore use identical local coordinates.

fixture_roles.Hull Canvas: Low crystalline grain with distributed, restrained catchlights.
fixture_roles.Silhouette: Continuous contour with sparse white stars.
fixture_roles.Jewelry: Hero six-head diamond glints with the strongest native-white peaks.
fixture_roles.Organs: Sparse structural stars phased by fixture identity.
fixture_roles.Identity: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel frost plaque from signIndex=index%74, with fine shimmer over a stable full-surface floor.

intent.te_sign_treatment: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel frost plaque from signIndex=index%74, with fine shimmer over a stable full-surface floor.
intent.jewelry_white: Jewelry gets exclusive hero treatment: the largest native-white accent rides crisp six-head diamonds while RGB maintains a visible rail between events.
intent.palette_white_material: No palette exports; warm-neutral RGB plus explicit W=A and U=0 makes the frost untintable and hardware-consistent.

audio_handles.intent: How much of the rig glitters.

intent.safety_floor: Each role owns a stable positive bed independent of density and sparkle phase; no sparse state can erase the whole ship.
intent.anti_duplication_notes: Keep it the sparse fine-detail member. Do not broaden glints into White Wash material, synchronize them into Breathe, line them up as Chase, or warm them into Temple candles.
intent.evidence_notes: The old test-bench capture showed isolated bright points over large near-black regions and no role hierarchy. The bold source retains exact controls/defaults/audio handles while broad crossing crystal planes make the motion legible and six-head Jewelry remains the fine-detail hero. At the saved review tune 121/166 test-bench pixels change materially over three seconds; all 74 Identity pixels are dynamic and both Titanic signs match exactly. Cross-model truth reports zero WRONG, WEAK, or DEAD controls. The gallery manifest fingerprints the exact source, goal registry, playlist, saved/effective values, duration, frame rate, and media shown on this row.

items.title: White Chase
items.goal: A white procession crosses the ship in role-specific ribbons, tracers, pearls, strikes, and sign scans.

intent.concept: A white procession crosses the ship in role-specific ribbons, tracers, pearls, strikes, and sign scans.
intent.design_intent: Retain a clear directional chase but stop projecting the same bar onto every fixture family; each instrument should express travel at its own scale.
intent.why_exists: It is the white family's explicit motion look and the strongest manual-direction performance handle.
intent.visual_goal_titanic: Broad Hull ribbons and a fine outline tracer should establish direction at distance, while six-head Jewelry marquee motion and discrete Organ hits provide close and structural authority.
intent.unique_topology: A fixed longitudinal X projection creates mirrored bow-to-stern processions; separate coordinates create a counter-moving Silhouette tracer, six-head Jewelry pearls, Organ cohorts, and one complete folded 74-pixel cross-scan.
intent.distance_silhouette: A narrower bright tracer travels across a permanently visible Silhouette, making both motion direction and ship outline legible.
intent.close_detail: Six-pearl rail marquees, fixture-cohort par strikes, broad Hull ribbon edges, and a restrained sign scan resolve at close range.
intent.motion_grammar: A manually signed long-wrap phase drives broad mirrored bow-to-stern travel; a counter-tracer and role-specific subordinate phases prevent lockstep repetition while controls slew without geometry jumps.
intent.xyz_use: Normalized longitudinal X establishes bow-to-stern travel while Y/Z preserve exact port-starboard mirroring and add vertical/depth facets; pixelLocalIndex builds Jewelry chases, and fixtureId builds Organ cohorts. Identity computes signIndex = index % 74 and remaps that folded address into one complete 10x8/74-pixel local surface; both physical 40+34 signs therefore use identical local coordinates.

fixture_roles.Hull Canvas: Broad white searchlight ribbons revealing Hull material.
fixture_roles.Silhouette: Narrower, brighter tracer over a continuous outline.
fixture_roles.Jewelry: Hero six-pearl marquee chase with strong native-white cores.
fixture_roles.Organs: Discrete structural strikes phased across fixtures.
fixture_roles.Identity: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel scan from signIndex=index%74, moving across one full readable plaque rather than restarting per panel.

intent.te_sign_treatment: Both physical signs render the same complete, non-repeating 74-pixel scan from signIndex=index%74, moving across one full readable plaque rather than restarting per panel.
intent.jewelry_white: Six-head Vintage rails carry the brightest native-white chase cores and the shortest local tail, preserving a fine Jewelry read.
intent.palette_white_material: No color palettes bind. RGB remains warm-neutral, W=A exactly, and UV=0 through every moving bar.

intent.safety_floor: Every instrument retains a white bed between processional cores; count, radius, and phase cannot create a whole-rig blackout.
intent.anti_duplication_notes: Protect explicit signed travel and multiple bar cores. It must not soften into Breathe, randomize into Shimmer, flatten into Wash, or slow into Temple's vigil.
intent.evidence_notes: The previous capture looked like one projection shared by the whole test bench. The bold rework preserves every public value and exact audio handle while replacing the generic projection with a mirrored bow-to-stern procession and distinct role counterpoint. At the saved review tune 101/166 test-bench pixels change materially over three seconds; all 74 Identity pixels are dynamic and both Titanic signs match exactly. Cross-model truth reports zero WRONG, WEAK, or DEAD controls.
